raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.15.0"

package:
  name: statsmodels
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/s/statsmodels/statsmodels-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5d257fe58d0772bc46a557880ca78e2a8e07fec7bfd9d11074aef8e33e1aecbc

build:
  number: 1
  skip: match(python, "<3.10")
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython >=3.0.13,<4
        - numpy >=2.0.0,<3
        - meson-python
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-scm >=9.2.0,<10
    - meson-python
    - cython >=3.0.13,<4
    - numpy
    - scipy >=1.13,<2
  run:
    - python
    - numpy >=1.23.5,<3
    - scipy >=1.8,!=1.9.2
    - pandas >=1.4,!=2.1.0
    - patsy >=0.5.6
    - packaging >=21.3
    - formulaic >=1.1.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - statsmodels
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Statistical computations and models for Python
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/statsmodels/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - tomaugspurger
    - croth1
    - ocefpaf
    - bashtage
